statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-58014 is an off-by-one out-of-bounds read of 1 byte in g_key_file_get_locale_string_list (glib/gkeyfile.c) when a key file has an empty value, which can cause a denial of service. Upstream fixed it in GLib 2.88.1 and 2.89.0 (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/issues/3930), and Debian backported the fix to trixie in 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-58014). This owner rebuilds Debian's trixie glib2.0 source. We unpacked libglib2.0-0t64 from every published build for amd64 and arm64. The three builds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u3 do not carry the fix: their package changelog has no entry for this CVE. The three builds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u5 do: their changelog includes the 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 entry that adds the patches from upstream 2.88.1 (the gkeyfile empty locale string list patch) and names this CVE. The range ends at the first build of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u5, the first published build with the fix.
